title: acer buergerianum var. ningpoense
intro: Acer buergerianum var. ningpoense, commonly known as the Ningpo Paperbark Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer buergerianum var. ningpoense include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
